data.one_liner: Save images and video files to the device gallery on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to save raw image bytes or local image and video files directly to the device photo gallery. Supports quality configuration and custom asset creation dates on iOS.
use_when: You need to save generated images, screenshots, or downloaded pictures to the device's photo gallery.
You need to save downloaded video files to the gallery.
avoid_when: You are only picking images from the gallery (use image_picker instead).
You only need to cache and load images in UI widgets.
strengths: Supports saving both raw image bytes and local files.
Supports iOS custom creation dates for saved assets.
weaknesses: Requires manual permission handling on Android.
iOS requires Info.plist usage description keys.
data.setup_notes: iOS requires adding NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription and NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription keys to Info.plist. Android requires storage permissions and requestLegacyExternalStorage on version 10.
